# HCC master trip catalog

**One source of truth per trip:** `src/content/trips/<trip>.md`, plus one file per dated departure in `src/content/departures/`. The departure files are generated by `npm run departures` from `tools/departure-schedules.json`. Every page reads these files:
- homepage, city hubs, destination pages and trip pages;
- booking card, sticky bar and WhatsApp messages;
- "At a glance" block and FAQs;
- structured data (TouristTrip and FAQPage) and the sitemap.

So a change made once appears everywhere. Never copy trip facts into page copy by hand. Where a guide must mention a trip, use the live components (`TripTable`, `TripCallout`); `npm run check:integrity` flags written prices that drift from live data.

## Field map (master catalog → where it lives)

| Field | Stored in | Per city? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip name | `title` (+ `seoName` for short titles) | – | |
| Destination | `destinations` (refs to `src/content/destinations`) | `stops` per city | |
| Departure city | `origins[].city` / `label` | ✅ | One trip page per city: `/trips/<trip>-from-<city>/` |
| Duration | `durationNights`, `durationDays` | `overnightTravel` per city | Shown as "2N/3D + overnight train travel" |
| Base price (one price per person) | `basePrice` | `origins[].basePrice` | The only customer-facing price |
| Reference price | `originalPrice` | `origins[].originalPrice` | Shown crossed out. Only if it was a genuine earlier price |
| Departure days | `recurrence` | `origins[].recurrence` | |
| Departure dates | `src/content/departures/*.yml` | ✅ (`origin`) | Past dates disappear automatically (build + browser safety net) |
| Departure / return time | `origins[].pickupPoints[].time`, `outbound`, `return`, `travelWindow` | ✅ | |
| Transport | `transportOptions` (included = `priceDelta: 0`) | `origins[].transport` | Paid alternatives are never shown with a price |
| Accommodation | `stays`, `stayOptions` | – | Same rule: no room-type prices |
| Itinerary | `itinerary` | `origins[].itinerary` | |
| Inclusions / exclusions | `inclusions`, `exclusions` | ✅ | |
| Difficulty, group size, age | `difficulty`, `groupSize`, `ageRange` | – | |
| Food | `itinerary[].meals` + inclusions/exclusions | – | |
| Booking / advance | `advanceAmount`, `gstPercent` | – | |
| Cancellation | `cancellationPolicy` (+ site policy page) | – | |
| Trip coordinator | inclusions text ("HCC trip captain…") | – | No separate field yet; add one only when HCC supplies named coordinators |
| Photos | `heroImage`, `gallery` (+ `credit`, `credit.ai`) | per-day itinerary images | No credit = HCC's own photo |
| FAQs | `faqs` (+ data-driven answers in `src/lib/trip-facts.ts`) | – | |
| SEO title / description | `seo.title`, `seo.description` (else generated by `src/lib/seo.ts`) | – | |
| Canonical | derived from the URL | – | Self-canonical, never set by hand |
| Index / noindex | `status: live` + `origins[].indexable` | ✅ | |
| Schema | derived (`src/lib/schema.ts`) | ✅ | Never hand-written |
| WhatsApp message | derived from title + city | ✅ | |
| Open questions | `origins[].incomplete` | ✅ | Internal only, never shown |

## WhatsApp Business Catalog intake

Nothing from the catalog is published straight away.

1. Record each catalog item in `catalog/whatsapp-intake.json`:
   - copy `_template`;
   - set `source: "WhatsApp Business Catalog"` and `status: "PENDING_APPROVAL"`;
   - paste the catalog text verbatim.
2. Fill `fields` **only** with what the catalog item states. Everything else stays `"NEEDS CONFIRMATION"`. Never guess.
3. Classify it:
   - **NEW_TRIP**: HCC has no such trip on the site.
   - **EXISTING_NO_CHANGE**: matches a site trip; nothing differs.
   - **EXISTING_UPDATE_NEEDED**: matches a site trip, but something differs. List each difference in `changes`.
   - **DUPLICATE**: same as another catalog item.
   - **CONFLICT**: disagrees with the site or another item in a way only HCC can resolve. List it in `conflicts`.
4. Run `npm run catalog:audit`. It suggests matching site trips, lists the missing fields, and rejects malformed entries.
5. When the owner approves the consolidated list:
   - set `status: "APPROVED"`;
   - apply the approved values to the trip files;
   - add the schedule to `tools/departure-schedules.json` and run `npm run departures`;
   - run `npm run check:all` after a production build.

## Reports

- `npm run catalog:audit` → `catalog/catalog-status.md`: completeness of every live trip × city, the NEEDS CONFIRMATION list, duplicates and the intake ledger.
- `npm run check:all` (after `PUBLIC_ALLOW_INDEXING=true npm run build`): SEO, links and integrity checks. Integrity covers price, date and city consistency, upgrade-price wording, claims and schema.
